summary: Replaced the process-wide settings with an immutable Settings value, settings.make(), and an explicit conf first parameter through every settings-dependent function, with the library entry points on the specified signatures (make_request takes declared_v2). Import-time reads and stale caches (units, dim divisor, freight minimum, fuel factor, fx and zone tables) were removed. The tests were moved to the new API (71 pass), and 1035 CLI runs plus in-process library calls matched the original package byte for byte.
